observations.content: User provided a context-only implementation packet for a later task: change durable memory from project-level `.memory/` to immutable session-specific `.memory/<sessionId>/`; discover fork parent via session header `parentSession` path and read its header ID, never using display names or filename IDs as identity; seed child memory once on first touch, excluding `.runs/`; leave root uncreated if parent header/root is unreadable or absent; never overwrite or reseed existing child memory on resume; route all durable reads/writes, compaction maps, journey access, and worker IPC through the owning session root, while preserving `/tree` ledger behavior and independent durable files.

Project is an observational-memory pi extension with an in-process orchestrator, shared subprocess worker extension (`OM_WORKER=observer|consolidator`), branch-local ledger observations, durable topic files and JOURNEY.md, deterministic compaction rendering, and TUI; default per-session gate is off via `om.enabled`.

Existing memory substrate in `src/memory/paths.ts` resolves project memory as `<cwd>/.memory/`, with INDEX.md, JOURNEY.md, topics, and transient `.runs`; `src/spawn/runs.ts` and `src/spawn/launch.ts` likewise locate worker IPC and OM_MEMORY_DIR under project-level `.memory/`. `src/hooks/compaction-hook.ts`, `src/commands/status.ts`, and `src/hooks/consolidator-trigger.ts` access memory/journey/index through cwd-based helpers.
Conversation packets repeatedly instructed CONTEXT_RECEIVED only; assistant acknowledged preparation turns 1–8 without implementation.

Reference design says fork/child memory must be seeded exactly once from parent memory, derive parent identity from parent session header ID via parentSession path, skip transient `.runs/`, preserve existing child data, and avoid creating an empty child root when parent has no readable header or memory root.
